headline: Bangladesh to Form Wage Board Following Garment Factory Protests
summary: Bangladesh announced plans to form a wage board after protests by garment workers forced factories to shut down.
why: Bangladesh is a major global hub for apparel manufacturing and garment exports, making labor stability and wage adjustments critical for supply chain continuity and operating costs for international brands.

impacts.name: Bangladesh
impacts.why: Labor disputes and wage board decisions impact apparel manufacturing output and operational costs.
